description: Two red ellipses, grouped, over a dark-blue bed; the group clip is masked by a rectangle covering the left 60% of the frame. Expect the left ellipse whole and the right one cut by a vertical edge at 60% of the width (x of about 77 of 128), so only its left sliver shows. A matte on a group reveals the whole group as one picture. What a wrong render looks like: both ellipses whole means the matte on the group was ignored; a white rectangle means the matte clip was drawn on its own track; the right ellipse fully gone or fully present means the matte was positioned wrongly.
